import os
import sys
import tempfile

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(sys.argv[1]))

import loaders

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
    os.chdir(tmp)
    with open("users.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("# name,email\nAda, ADA@example.com\n\nBob,bob-at-example\nCy,cy@example.com,extra\nDee,dee@example.com\n")
    with open("products.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("ab-1, 9.50\nzz-9, free\n# comment\nq-2,3\n")
    with open("broken.csv", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("only-one-field\n")
    print(loaders.load_users("users.csv"))
    print(loaders.load_products("products.csv"))
    for func in (loaders.load_users, loaders.load_products):
        try:
            func("broken.csv")
        except SystemExit as exc:
            print(func.__name__, "SystemExit", exc)
        try:
            func("missing.csv")
        except FileNotFoundError as exc:
            print(func.__name__, "FileNotFoundError", exc.filename)
    os.chdir("/")
print("ok")
